verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only hosted API access to Grok models, through xAI's API, Vertex AI and Foundry. It contains no downloadable weights, no weights license, and no first-party statement that the weights are closed. The only reference to closed status is a community comment calling Grok a closed-source model, which is not the platform itself being transparent about weights availability.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can download the model weights under a stated license and run them myself — or the platform is honest that weights are closed
